name: Handoffs keep authority, budget and cancellation
purpose: A piece goes to its worker only with the authority, within the budget and while the request is not cancelled; otherwise it is refused with the reason, and a stop reaches the worker's own hook.
record: Conformance cases written here (tests/test_orchestrate_parts.py) over recording workers: allowed, refused for authority, refused for the pieces budget, cancelled before a piece and a stop hook handed through Tools.
disadvantages: Recording workers, not a live agent session; the dollar part of the budget needs a worker that reports its cost.
